sn45.32:1.2: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the one practising wrongly and the one practising rightly.
sn45.32:1.4: “And what, bhikkhus, is the one practising wrongly?
sn45.32:1.5: Here someone is of wrong view … wrong concentration.
sn45.32:1.6: This is called the one practising wrongly.
sn45.32:1.7: “And what, bhikkhus, is the one practising rightly?
sn45.32:1.8: Here someone is of right view … right concentration.
sn45.32:1.9: This is called the one practising rightly.”
